error_pattern: Could not determine the correct NetSuite Subsidiary
example_error: Could not determine the correct NetSuite Subsidiary for this bill. Ensure this entity is associated with a NetSuite subsidiary within your Ramp Accounting Settings.
cause: DRAFT: Ramp entity not mapped to a subsidiary in Ramp accounting settings.

error_pattern: Invalid Field Value (?P<value>.+?) for the following field: subsidiary
example_error: You have entered an Invalid Field Value 3 for the following field: subsidiary
cause: DRAFT: Vendor not assigned to that subsidiary in NetSuite.

error_pattern: Please enter value\(s\) for: Primary Subsidiary
example_error: Please enter value(s) for: Primary Subsidiary
cause: DRAFT: Vendor record missing its primary subsidiary.

error_pattern: Bill has no Entity or Subsidiary
example_error: Bill has no Entity or Subsidiary
cause: DRAFT: The bill's Ramp entity has no NetSuite subsidiary connected.

error_pattern: Please enter value\(s\) for: (?P<field>.+)
example_error: Please enter value(s) for: Location
cause: DRAFT: NetSuite marks a field mandatory that Ramp did not send.

error_pattern: The values for (?P<field>.+?) must be consistent across all line items
example_error: The values for Location must be consistent across all line items for synchronization. This data is used in both Payment and Expense journal entries. To modify these values post-sync, do so within NetSuite.
cause: DRAFT: Split lines carry different locations.

error_pattern: You cannot Create or Edit this Vendor Bill without an attachment
example_error: Missing Attachment : You cannot Create or Edit this Vendor Bill without an attachment, please attach a vendor invoice
cause: DRAFT: The NetSuite bill form makes an attachment mandatory.

error_pattern: Invalid Reference Id : Accounts element id \[(?P<account>[^\]]+)\]
example_error: Invalid Reference Id | Invalid Reference Id : Accounts element id [6120].
cause: DRAFT: Inactive or invalid account selected in Ramp settings.

error_pattern: Invalid account reference key (?P<account>\S+) for subsidiary
example_error: Invalid account reference key 6310 for subsidiary NW CA
cause: DRAFT: Account not assigned to the subsidiary.

error_pattern: Invalid Field Value (?P<account>.+?) for the following field: account
example_error: You have entered an Invalid Field Value 6120 for the following field: account
cause: DRAFT: The account is inactive, a summary account, or not available to this subsidiary.

error_pattern: account \((?P<internal_id>[^)]+)\) you chose is not a valid selection in NetSuite
example_error: We weren't able to sync across the following transaction, as it appears the account (1482) you chose is not a valid selection in NetSuite.
cause: DRAFT: A field option chosen in Ramp, most often a vendor or account, is no longer valid in NetSuite, usually because it's inactive or deleted.

error_pattern: there is already a vendor using that entity name
example_error: we weren't able to process your sync due to this error. there is already a vendor using that entity name. all vendors must have a unique entity name.
cause: DRAFT: Duplicate vendor records in NetSuite.

error_pattern: Unauthorized user
example_error: Unauthorized User
cause: DRAFT: Connecting user left, lost the Ramp Accountant role, or the integration record is blocked.

error_pattern: Permission Violation:.*Pay Bills
example_error: Permission Violation: You need a higher level of the 'Transactions -> Pay Bills' permission to access this page. Please contact your account administrator.
cause: DRAFT: Integration role lacks bill payment permission.

error_pattern: Permission Violation:.*Credit Card
example_error: Permission Violation: You need a higher level of the Transactions > Credit Card permission to access this page. Please contact your account administrator.
cause: DRAFT: Integration role lacks the Credit Card transaction permission.

error_pattern: INVALID_LOGIN_ATTEMPT
example_error: INVALID_LOGIN_ATTEMPT
cause: DRAFT: The integration's NetSuite login stopped working (expired token, locked user, or changed role).

error_pattern: unable to sync this bill due to an invalid reference in NetSuite
example_error: We were unable to sync this bill due to an invalid reference in NetSuite.
cause: DRAFT: The matched PO is still pending receipt and NetSuite is not set to allow billing before receipt.

error_pattern: purchase order lines that have already been fully billed: (?P<po_lines>.+)
example_error: This bill is matched to purchase order lines that have already been fully billed: PO-2231 line 2
cause: DRAFT: The bill is matched to PO lines with nothing left to bill.

error_pattern: You cannot add a closed purchase order line to a Vendor Bill
example_error: You cannot add a closed purchase order line to a Vendor Bill.
cause: DRAFT: The bill points at a PO line that is already closed in NetSuite.

error_pattern: Skipping the syncing of this payment due to unsynced reimbursements
example_error: Skipping the syncing of this payment due to unsynced reimbursements in the payment batch.
cause: DRAFT: Bills in the batch have not synced yet.

error_pattern: because the bill is already marked as paid in NetSuite
example_error: Your bill payment couldn't be synced because the bill is already marked as paid in NetSuite
cause: DRAFT: The bill was already paid in NetSuite outside of Ramp.

error_pattern: because the bill is pending approval in NetSuite
example_error: Your bill payment couldn't be synced because the bill is pending approval in NetSuite. Bill payments for bills pending approval cannot be created in NetSuite.
cause: DRAFT: The bill is still waiting for approval in NetSuite.

error_pattern: The accounting period is closed in your accounting provider
example_error: The accounting period is closed in your accounting provider. Please open the period or change the accounting date to fall within an open period.
cause: DRAFT: Transaction date falls in a closed period.

error_pattern: The G/L impact of a transaction in a closed period cannot be changed
example_error: The G/L impact of a transaction in a closed period cannot be changed.
cause: DRAFT: A change in Ramp would alter a bill already posted to a closed period.

error_pattern: Allow Non-G/L Changes
example_error: You cannot make changes to this period. You need the Allow Non-G/L Changes permission and must set the Allow Non-G/L Changes preference in the period record.
cause: DRAFT: The period is locked against non-G/L changes.
